CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  May 13, 2025

  The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – May 13, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Anki Udani, Vice Chairman

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  PRESENTATION:

  Presentation regarding the City of Alhambra Objective Design Standards and Design Guidelines
  project to the Design Review Board by project consultant RRM Design Group.

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – April 22, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the March 22, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the April 22, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

  1
  05/13/2025
 E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-015
  • 214 South Atlantic Boulevard
  • Applicant: Panache Engineering Inc., Hazem Saleh
  • Request: This is an application for a new 9-foot-high CMU screening
  structure for a new emergency generator at grade on an existing
  residential property known as Atherton Baptist Homes.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-006
  • 513 South Hidalgo Avenue
  • Applicant: Jin Xiong Huang
  • Request: This is an application for a new 3-foot-high sliding gate,
  front yard fence and wall, a new 6-foot-high wall and gate outside of
  the front yard, and a new concrete ramp with railing on an existing
  single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS - The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the front yard fence graphics to accurately reflect the
  proposed fence design.
  2) Clarify if a new 3-foot-high pedestrian gate is proposed along the
  front yard.
  3) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Revise the front yard fence graphics to accurately reflect the
  proposed fence design.
  2) Show on the plans where the new 3-foot-high pedestrian gate is
  proposed along the front yard.

  2
  05/13/2025
   3) Adjust the new concrete steps in the front yard to allow for a
  gate to swing in toward the property.
  4) Setback the new 6 ft. high wall and gate a minimum of 12” from
  the front face of the main house to expose the building corner.
  5) Update the 6 ft. high wall and gate graphics to identify finish and
  to accurately depict its location on the East Elevation.
  6) Provide a graphic representation of the new ramp and related
  railing in elevation.
  7) Provide a low screening wall along the east side of the ramp to
  provide some level of screening.
  8) The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for City
  Architect to verify and approve.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB- 25-045
  • 116 West Main Street
  • Applicant: Jorge Rosa
  • Request: This is an application for tenant improvements to an
  existing 1,528 SF 1-story commercial building that includes exterior
  improvements to doors, storefronts, wall treatments, and roof
  equipment screening.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-036
  • 1210 North Atlantic Boulevard
  • Applicant: Ryan Ybarra
  • Request: This is an application for two (2) new directional signs, one
  (1) menu board sign, and to relocate one (1) existing freestanding
  pylon sign on an existing commercial property known as “In-N-Out”.
  3
  05/13/2025
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVE WITH CONDITIONS. The
  proposed project is approved with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Should a new pole, pylon, or any part of the existing freestanding
  sign structure be replaced or fabricated as new, then the overall
  sign height shall be reduced to comply with the maximum height
  limit of 20 feet required by the Alhambra Zoning Code.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Should a new pole, pylon, or any part of the existing freestanding
  sign structure be replaced or fabricated as new, then the overall
  sign height shall be reduced to comply with the maximum height
  limit of 20 feet required by the Alhambra Zoning Code.
  2) Update the notes for Sign #C to show existing paint to remain.
  Make clear no new paint or materials are proposed.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 3-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Hernandez
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 6:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-002
  • 2128 Winthrop Drive
  • Applicant: Frank Wong
  • Request: This is an application for exterior improvements and front
  porch re-design on an existing 1-story Colonial Revival style single-
  family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.
MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:

  1) Simplify the level of detail for the front porch roof cornice.
  2) Update the railing graphics to match the level of detail as
  proposed along the front porch.

  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Daninger.
